sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed to declare the action of respondent Nos.4 and 5 in not initiating the proceedings under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the Act, 2013") in respect of the land admeasuring Ac.0.29 guntas in Sy.No.96/2 situated at Kannala Village, Bellampally Mandal,
Mancherial District, which was affected while formation of railway over bridge as illegal, arbitrary and violative of Articles, 14, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and consequently prayed to direct respondent Nos.4 and 5 to submit requisition proposal pursuant to the letter of respondent No.3 vide Rc.No.C20214/98/2022, dated 13.06.2024 and direct respondent Nos.2 to 4 to pay the compensation to the petitioner and for other appropriate reliefs.
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is stated that the petitioner is the owner and possessor of land admeasuring Ac.5.00 guntas in sy.Nos.94, 95 and 96/2 situated at Kannala Village, Bellampally Mandal, Mancherial District.

It is further stated that the said land was allotted by CVBR, J Wp_27607_2024 the Government under Ex-Servicemen quota vide proceedings No.B/2598/1990, dated 10.08.1990 and the revenue authorities also recorded the name of the petitioner as pattadar and possessor and he is also receiving the amount of Raithubandu (investment subsidy) for cultivation of the said land.

It is further stated that out of Ac.3.29 guntas of land in Sy.No.96/2, the land to an extent of Ac.0.29 guntas was affected for formation of railway over bridge and without initiating the proceedings under the provisions of the Act, 2013, the Roads and Buildings department has proceeded with the construction of railway over bridge and the petitioner has submitted a representation, dated 13.03.2015 wherein a survey was conducted by the Deputy Inspector of Survey, Adilabad and it was identified that as per the report, dated 06.04.2015, land admeasuring Ac.0.29 guntas was affected for construction of the railway over bridge.

It is further stated that acting on the said representations submitted by the petitioner, vide letter, dated 13.06.2024, respondent No.3 requested respondent No.4-the Executive Engineer (R&B) Division, Mancherial, to submit the requisition proposals as per the provisions of the Act, 2013 to respondent No.5

and on receipt of such requisition from respondent No.4, respondent No.5 is requested to process the CVBR, J Wp_27607_2024 land acquisition proposals as per the provisions of the Act, 2013 and pay the compensation to the petitioner.
The grievance of the petitioner is that even after receiving the said communication,
respondent No.4 has not sent any proposals to enable the other authorities to initiate the proceedings for payment of compensation.

3. Considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, appearing for respondent Nos.1,3 and 5 and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Roads and Buildings, appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 4 and Yenaganti Shankaraiah vs The State Of Telangana on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49583859/

sentences.text: with their consent this writ petition is disposed of at the admission stage.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition has not disputed the letter addressed by respondent No.3 requesting respondent No.4 to submit the requisition proposals to enable the authorities to initiate the land acquisition proceedings.

5. In view of the above submissions, this Court is of the opinion that the ends of justice would be met if respondent No.4 is directed to take action on the letter, dated 13.06.2024 addressed by respondent No.3 for submitting requisition CVBR, J Wp_27607_2024 proposals within a period of two (02) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
6.
With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
7. As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE C.V.BHASKAR REDDY 03.10.2024 gkv Yenaganti Shankaraiah vs The State Of Telangana on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49583859/
